description:
Cast Primordial Hydra for {X} = 0.
Primordial Hydra dies due to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Forest adding {G}.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Primordial Hydra, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
